propositions: Build-and-test command set is hand-copied between test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml, creating drift risk that requires a separate parity-test policer.
The monolithic build-and-test job in gerrit-verify.yaml runs lint/pip-audit/test inline within a 4x matrix, causing lint steps to execute redundantly for each matrix element.
A single reusable workflow_call file (_build-and-test.yml) with parameterized checkout (gerrit-refspec, gerrit-project, gerrit-url) eliminates the copy and makes drift impossible by construction.

Five test_ci_workflow_parity.py safety functions must be preserved and retargeted: gate-presence, script-gate asymmetry, branch-sensitive precommit hooks, redundant hook skipping, and optionality-contract validation.

Both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must delegate to the shared reusable; gerrit-verify's build-and-test job remains named identically and vote still lists it in needs for end-to-end Verified vote compatibility.
